title: 第17章 敷衍现在还给你们第18章 林默是真的火了
slug: 律师霸凌者无罪我送他死刑
content_zh:
接著林默看向周围的记者们。
“我该说的都说完了，不再接受採访。”
说完，林默转身离去，本来脸上还有复杂神色的王大海和王乐乐也坚定了表情。
跟上了林默。
林默挺著笔直的身躯，眼神坚定，抬著头走下法院的台阶。
这一刻，林默才像是一个打贏了官司意气风发的律师。
年轻，帅气，正义。
台阶下面站了不少人，林默望去，看见了几个熟悉的人。
有吴佳和焦文栋等人，还有一些穿著校服的高中生。
正面色欣喜的看著自己。
林默知道，他们都是王乐乐的同学。
“乐乐，去吧，去告诉朋友们这个好消息。”林默笑道。
“是！”王乐乐也笑了，奔跑著过去。
这一刻，王乐乐的笑容才显示出了真正的青春，一群少年都露出了轻鬆的笑容。
围绕在一起分享著开心的消息。
“对了，王哥赶紧回去看看嫂子吧，把这个好消息带给他。”
王大海一愣，脸上也是露出笑容：“是啊！”
记住我们101看书网
而就在这时候，法庭前的道路上驶来了一辆警车。
下来了五个警察，每个人都愁容满面，一下车就急冲冲的走上台阶，看样子是要直奔法院。

林默一看，队伍里面正好有一个熟人。
那位陈警官，当初认定王乐乐一家是在无理取闹的那位警官。
而此刻，他的脸色最为凝重，仿佛受到巨大批评一样。
往上走的同时他也见到了林默，他脸色瞬间激动了起来，越过队伍大步迈到了林默的身前。
直接伸手抓住了林默的衣领子，脸色涨的通红的问道：
“林默！为什么！你有这种证据为什么不报案！”
林默淡然一笑，看得出来，这起官司引起的社会舆论已经快速影响到了当时主持这件案子的陈警官。
这一幕也吸引了所有人的目光。
王乐乐和他的同学们也都看了过来。
见到是陈警官后，一个个脸色复杂。
儘管被拉著衣领，但林默依旧很淡定的说道：
“我报警了，可陈警官您好像不太信任我们，所以我觉得这种重要证据还是交给法院比较好。”
“你！放屁！有这种確凿的证据我怎么可能不管！”
content_en:
Then Lin Mo looked at the reporters around him.
"I have said all that I need to say and will no longer accept interviews."
After saying that, Lin Mo turned and left. Wang Dahai and Wang Lele, who originally had complicated expressions on their faces, also had firm expressions.
Followed Lin Mo.
Lin Mo walked down the steps of the court with his straight body and firm eyes, his head held high.
At this moment, Lin Mocai looked like a lawyer who was very excited after winning the lawsuit.
Young, handsome, and righteous.
There were many people standing under the steps. Lin Mo looked around and saw a few familiar people.
There were Wu Jia, Jiao Wendong and others, as well as some high school students in school uniforms.
He looked at himself with a happy expression.
Lin Mo knew that they were all Wang Lele's classmates.
"Lele, go ahead and tell your friends the good news." Lin Mo said with a smile.
"Yes!" Wang Lele also smiled and ran over.
At this moment, Wang Lele's smile showed his true youth, and a group of teenagers all showed relaxed smiles.
Sharing happy news together.
"By the way, Brother Wang, please go back and see your sister-in-law quickly and bring him the good news."
Wang Dahai was stunned, with a smile on his face: "Yes!"

At this moment, a police car drove up on the road in front of the court.
Five policemen got off, each with a sad look on their face. They hurried up the steps as soon as they got off the car, apparently going straight to the court.
Lin Mo took a look and saw that there happened to be an acquaintance in the team.
That police officer Chen was the one who initially believed that Wang Lele's family was making trouble unreasonably.
At this moment, his expression was the most solemn, as if he had been greatly criticized.
As he walked up, he also saw Lin Mo. His face instantly became excited, and he crossed the line and strode in front of Lin Mo.
He reached out and grabbed Lin Mo's collar, and asked with his face flushed:
"Lin Mo! Why! Why didn't you report the case when you had this kind of evidence!"
Lin Mo smiled calmly. It was obvious that the public opinion caused by this lawsuit had quickly affected Officer Chen, who was in charge of the case at the time.
This scene also attracted everyone's attention.
Wang Lele and his classmates also looked over.
After seeing it was Officer Chen, everyone had complicated expressions.
Although being pulled by the collar, Lin Mo still said calmly:
"I called the police, but Officer Chen doesn't seem to trust us, so I think it's better to hand this important evidence to the court."
"You! Fart! How could I ignore such conclusive evidence!"
